claims.claim: Epiphanius of Salamis was bishop of Constantia (Salamis), the metropolis of the island of Cyprus.
Epiphanius was born near Eleutheropolis, Palestine, after 310 and died in 403.
Epiphanius was elected bishop of Salamis (Constantia) in 367 and fulfilled the duties of the episcopate for nearly forty years.
The list attributed to Epiphanius is an expanded version that replaced an earlier anonymous list of apostles and disciples.
The text survives in Greek manuscripts and was edited by Theodor Schermann in 1907 based on multiple manuscripts including ABCDF and Latin translations.
